 Follow Kim Kardashian Is Literally Glowing in Her Latest Red Carpet Beauty Look
 Tiffany Dodson Davis Wed, October 28, 2026 at 8:15 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kim Kardashian Glows in Her Latest Red Carpet Look Medios y Media - Getty Images "Hearst Magazines and Yahoo may earn commission or revenue on some items through these links." 
 Kim Kardashian is no stranger to glamorous red carpet looks, as evidenced by her recent press tour for All's Fair season two. Yesterday, while promoting the show in Mexico City, fans and Bazaar editors alike were captivated not only by the star's plunging Fall/Winter 2026 Schiaparelli couture gown but also by her diffused makeup look for the occasion, created by one of her longtime artists, Ariel Tejada .
 Kim Kardashian poses on the red carpet at the season two premiere of All's Fair in Mexico CityMedios y Media - Getty Images
 Medios y Media - Getty Images
 Kardashian's soft-focus glam gave her an ethereal, lit-from-within glow that seemed subtler and more natural than the chiseled, contoured looks she's helped popularize over the years. Aside from the radiant skin and a light wash of blush applied strategically to the high points of her cheeks, Tejada kept the star's makeup fairly simple with a sculpted, cool-toned mauve and nude lip combo and elongated wispy lashes. Kardashian's sleek, center-parted hair was styled behind her ears and shoulders by celebrity stylist Igor Rosales-Jackson , which allowed the striking Schiaparelli gown to have its statement moment.
 Advertisement Advertisement It's no secret that All's Fair has garnered plenty of buzz for its elevated fashion looks in its first season. As Mexico City is only the second stop on its international press tour, we're betting Kardashian has plenty more showstopping glam planned before the show's season two premiere on November 4.
